subject: Difficulty removing non habitat from mask

messages.author: bdbdd16043b71751
messages.subject: Difficulty removing non habitat from mask
parts:
I'm having a difficult time removing non-habitat from my mask. Right now I am creating my mask as follows:
  • areafile <- paste0("TrapsBuffer10km.shp") #bounding polygon
  • area1 <- rgdal::readOGR(dsn = areafile, layer = "TrapsBuffer10km")
  • mask1 <- make.mask(alltraps, buffer = 40000, type = "trapbuffer", poly = area1)
Further, I am adding landscape covariates as follows (water as example):
  • waterareafile <- paste0("water15kmproj.shp")
  • waterarea <- rgdal::readOGR(dsn = waterareafile, layer = "water15kmproj")
  • mask1<-addCovariates(mask1, waterarea, columns="water", replace=F)
I would like to remove the water=1 landcover from the mask but I can't seem to get the function subset() to work for me. I attached an image to show the mask and water covariate. Basically, I would like the mask to be water=0. Any ideas would be helpful. I apologize if this is a simple problem, but I can't seem to figure it out. Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Difficulty removing non habitat from mask
parts:
Did you try something like this?
mask2 <- subset(mask1, covariates(mask1)$water != 1)
